_decision: darkHoverBg = oklch(0.301 0 0). a rail button's hover overlay. The value comes from proposedDarkRailTokens — the approved decision record — NOT from measuring the component and writing down what it happened to say. If this check fails, that is the finding.
_serialisation: The expected string is the COMPUTED spelling. tokens.css authors some colours as oklch(55.6% 0 0) while the browser computes oklch(0.556 0 0) — the same colour, and compare() is exact string equality. proposedDarkRailTokens already uses the computed spelling, so the value is copied unchanged. Never resolve a mismatch by pasting the measured value.
_scope: The rail had NO hover feedback at all for most of Build (M-12): the button carried hover:bg-transparent, suppressing Button's own ghost hover without substituting the dark-rail token. This check is what makes that regression mechanical rather than something a human has to notice again.
